newsitem.title: UZBEKISTAN: Uzbekistan leases a third A-310 passenger jetliner.
newsitem.headline: Uzbekistan leases a third A-310 passenger jetliner.

text.p: Uzbekistan's national airline said late on Wednesday that it had leased a third Airbus A-310 passenger jet from France-based Airbus Industrie for 12 years.
Arslan Ruzmetov, director of flag carrier Uzbekiston Khavo Yullari, said the aircraft would fly international routes from the capital Tashkent along with two other A-310s bought in 1993.
Ruzmetov said the purchase of the first two jets and the leasing of the third had cost about $100 million.
The 193-seat jetliner is due for delivery in May 1998.
In 1995, the airline bought two Boeing-767s and one Boeing-757 for a total of $220 million and last year ordered three 80-seat Avro RJ-85 aeroplanes from British Aerospace Plc.
With 100 mostly Soviet-built passenger aircraft, the airline carried 2.3 million passengers in 1996.
